items.stem: Which customer-support case is least suitable for an autonomous AI reply?

options.text: A distressed customer with a complex complaint and compensation request
options.rationale: Correct: high-emotion, high-stakes cases need human empathy and judgement.
Routine, low-risk requests are well suited to AI assistance.

options.text: A request for standard opening hours
options.rationale: Simple factual answers suit AI with verification.
Common how-to questions are a good AI fit.

items.explanation: Correct: high-emotion, high-stakes cases need human empathy and judgement.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Before sending an AI-drafted reply to a customer, which TWO checks matter most? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Confirm the stated policy or fact against the knowledge base
options.rationale: Correct: AI can invent policies, so facts must be verified.

options.text: Check the tone is appropriate for the customer's situation
options.rationale: Correct: tone must fit the context, especially for upset customers.

options.text: Send it faster than any human could
options.rationale: Speed is not a correctness check and can cause harm.

options.text: Assume the AI is always right about policy
options.rationale: Assuming correctness is exactly the risk to avoid.

items.explanation: Correct: AI can invent policies, so facts must be verified.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A team measures only average handling time after adding AI. What is the risk?

options.text: Service quality can fall unnoticed because quality is not being measured
options.rationale: Correct: optimising speed alone can mask declining resolution quality and satisfaction.

options.text: Handling time is the only metric that matters
options.rationale: Quality and resolution matter alongside speed.
AI does not guarantee quality; it must be measured.

options.text: There is no risk to tracking one metric
options.rationale: A single metric can hide important failures.

items.explanation: Correct: optimising speed alone can mask declining resolution quality and satisfaction.
